criteria.statement: Generated avatar image bytes can be uploaded to Blossom.
Successful Blossom upload returns an avatar ref in blossom:<sha256> format.
When Blossom is unavailable or upload fails, a direct HTTP(S) avatar URL can be returned as the ref fallback.
Avatar refs can be resolved for preview from either blossom:<sha256> or direct URL refs.
Provisioning stores the portable ref in assets.avatar_ref and keeps avatar_url as the preview/profile URL.
